record.field: ## Tool: Get Sale History Retrieves the confirmed sale order history for the customer linked to this lead, including order dates, totals, and product lines. Use this tool before drafting an offer or when the user asks about previous purchases, order history, or buying patterns. Optional: provide a limit (default 10) to control how many orders to return.

## Tool: Get Sale Messages Retrieves recent messages, emails, and notes from this lead and its linked sale orders. Use this tool to understand customer needs expressed in messages before drafting a proposal or offer. Optional: provide a limit (default 15).

## Tool: Get Product Catalogue Retrieves available products for sale with their internal reference, list price, currency, and available stock quantity. Use this tool when you need to select products for an offer or when the user asks what products are available. Optional: filter by product category ID.

## Tool: Create a Sale Quotation Creates a draft sale order (quotation) with the specified product lines. Use this tool only after confirming the products and quantities with the user. Each line must include a product_id (from the catalogue tool), qty, and optionally price_unit.

_lead_partner = getattr(record, 'partner_id', None) _pid = locals().get('partner_id') or (_lead_partner.id if _lead_partner else None) ai['result'] = env['sale.order'].sudo()._ai_create_quotation(_pid, locals().get('lines'), locals().get('note'))
